name: Verovio
category: A4. Vector, typography, diagrams and stills
role: MEI, MusicXML, Humdrum and ABC scores engraved to SVG with a native CLI, Python or WASM
summary: Verovio is a C++ music engraver from RISM Digital. It reads MEI, MusicXML, Humdrum and ABC and writes SVG with the bundled Leipzig SMuFL font, plus MIDI and a timemap of note onsets for playback sync. It is a library or CLI, not an editor. Notation glyphs are SVG paths with semantic classes (note, notehead, measure); titles and lyrics are font-dependent <text>. Element ids are random unless xmlIdSeed is set.
use_when: Print-quality engraved notation as an SVG layer from MusicXML, MEI, Humdrum or ABC
In-process Python or WASM engraving with no browser, and a timemap for syncing highlights to audio
Per-note styling: SVG notes carry note and notehead classes and stable ids when seeded
avoid_when: Reading or analysing symbolic music with no drawing: music21 or mido
Plain bars, chords or a piano roll: draw with svg or canvas-2d
A permissive licence is required for bundled code: Verovio is LGPL-3.0-only; OpenSheetMusicDisplay is BSD-3-Clause
notes: 2026-11-27: Lead version 6.4.1 confirmed on PyPI; installed the arm64 wheel into a venv, no brew.
2026-11-27: Default SVG ids are random per process, so output differs every run; set the xmlIdSeed option for byte-identical output.
2026-11-27: resvg clipped the title (text-anchor middle on a nested tspan); lyrics were fine.
2026-11-27: LGPL-3.0-only: calling the library or CLI as a dependency is the low-friction route; check obligations before bundling it.

assessment.rationale: Lead dated 2026-11-19: release 6.4.1 (2026-11-03), repository pushed 2026-11-18, LGPL-3.0-only (free software). Engraves four score formats to SVG; music21 and mido do not draw. Python wheel installs without system software.

evidence.result: 4-bar MusicXML to SVG via Python wheel in venv, twice in separate processes: identical only with xmlIdSeed=1 (default ids random, check failed without it); 1 page, 4 measures, 10 notes, 10 timemap note-ons, 10 <text>; resvg 0.47.0 PNG 1800x366 inspected (title clipped by resvg).
evidence.scope: One 4-bar MusicXML melody, Python wheel, macOS arm64; not MEI/Humdrum/ABC, CLI, WASM, MIDI, fonts, multi-page, Chromium or note animation.
